gist.summary: Added @Saauf’s Pollinations Blocks to the build app catalog and README showcase. The Android extension brings Pollinations text, images, speech, AAC/M4A recording and transcription, and questions about picked images to MIT App Inventor and Kodular. Device sign-in lets users spend their own Pollen. The README’s recent-apps list now features it in place of Pollinations NPC for Roblox.

image.prompt: In a cozy garden workshop, Polli wears a tiny tool belt and helps snap colorful coding blocks beside an Android phone showing a flower image, a speech bubble, and an audio waveform; a code-plant grows beside them. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, never oversized, and strictly pixel art. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, chunky retro sprites, soft pastel gradients, a prominent soft lime green (#ecf874) glow against warm cream, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but emotionally warm.
